meta_description: Your own writing styles, in every app. Rewrite, translate, reply.
h1: Rewrite in *your style*, in every app.
accroche: A message does not carry the same tone in a work e-mail, a classified ad, or a note to someone close. Plume is the wardrobe of your writing styles: you pick yours, it applies inside the app you are in. You keep your keyboard, you keep your app, and you are the one who sends.
demo_recu: Are we still meeting tomorrow for the project?
demo_brouillon: yeah free tmrw tell me what time
demo_direct: Yes, I'm free tomorrow. Tell me the time.
demo_pro: Hello, I am available tomorrow. Could you confirm the time?
demo_complice: Yes, absolutely, I'm free tomorrow! Tell me what time works for you.
demo_romantique: Tomorrow, with pleasure. Tell me the time, I can't wait to see you.
demo_consigne: Pick a style, then tap the capsule.
geste_intro: Plume puts a floating capsule on top of the apps you choose. Everywhere else, it stays invisible.
tap_texte: Your text is rewritten in the current style, or translated.
long_texte: Plume suggests a reply to what is on your screen.
micro_texte: You speak, your text lands in the input field.
styles_intro: Here, a writing style is called a persona. Some come free, more are waiting in the catalogue.
styles_tienne_texte: With the subscription, you create your own personas: Plume then writes like you, not like everyone else.
regles_texte: Assign a persona or a mode to each app: your messaging app in Friendly, your work network in Professional. The right tone applies the moment you open it.
regles_note: Apps you do not configure follow your home style.
lecture_texte: Translate what you read: manga, webtoons, foreign apps. The translation appears on top of the text, in its place: you read in your language without copying anything.
lecture_langues: Plume speaks your language, and translates into dozens of others.
lecture_consigne: Tap "Translate": the translation lands on the text.
conf_titre: You choose *where your text is processed*
local_texte: Local mode translates on your phone: nothing is sent, it works offline — but not every language is equally covered there.
cloud_texte: Cloud AI mode applies your persona's tone and covers those languages; your text then travels to an AI service located outside the European Union, for the time of the processing. Plume keeps none of it.
ia_texte: The subscription adds an AI that runs on the device: offline, no quota.
autorisations_titre: Permissions, and what Plume does not do
autorisations_texte: Plume uses the Android accessibility service to read and replace the text in the field you are writing in, when you tap the capsule, and only in the apps you linked yourself. Assisted Reading asks for your screen capture consent again at every session. It sends nothing in the background, and it never sends a message for you.
final_texte: Plume is free to use, with a number of rewrites per day; a rewarded ad unlocks more whenever you decide, never forced on you. The subscription raises the caps, opens the whole catalogue and removes the ads.
final_signature: Plume does not teach you how to write. It gives you the right tone, at the moment you write.
